name: wasm3
description: Vendored wasm3 WebAssembly interpreter for the spike/wasm3-apps spike. Upstream: github.com/wasm3/wasm3 commit d77cd814aa0bc68cb1df917580a6304d34cfb30b (2026-06-26, source/ directory only). Local patches (grep 'CYBERFIDGET SPIKE PATCH'): (1) d_m3CustomAllocator hook in m3_core.c so the host can route allocations to ESP32 PSRAM (see lib/WasmAppRuntime); (2) d_m3NativeStackGuard hook in m3_core.h/m3_exec.h so deep wasm call chains trap (m3Err_trapStackOverflow) instead of overrunning the native task stack and rebooting the device. M3_IN_IRAM is defined to keep interpreter opcodes OUT of IRAM (wasm3 defaults to IRAM_ATTR on ESP32; the name is upstream's, not a typo). -O2 overrides the project-wide -Os for interpreter speed.
